verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents fast, low-code acceptance paths: a Hosted Payment Page billed as ready "in less than a day", no-code Payment Links, and a public test-account signup. However, onboarding is sales-led: merchants must "get in touch with our team" for a tailored plan and there is no self-serve rate card, so going live with real card payments within a day of signing up is not evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented self-serve signup-to-live timeline, evidence of instant merchant underwriting or activation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day live acceptance.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: Get a fully branded checkout page in less than a day. No heavy lifting or confusing compliance.
